title: poa aurea
intro: Poa aurea, commonly known as Golden Foxtail, is a perennial grass native to Europe and western Asia. It is used in herbal medicine due to its health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and improving digestion. The plant's therapeutic actions are attributed to its ability to stimulate bowel movements and relieve symptoms of irritable bowel syndrome. The bioactive constituents of Poa aurea include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
